about: Leftover classes of tools/bench/triage.py, first match wins in this order. A class matches a block by its end ("ends": the bench report's run end) or a leftover by "regex" (Python re.search, DOTALL) on the leftover head: `pure <conclusion>` for an exported pure goal (its conclusion as ResidualExport prints it, every application in `@f args` form), `spatial <goal skeleton>` or `spatial-call <goal skeleton>` for a spatial goal (skeleton of the last step before it, spaces printed as `_`; -call when the caller's premises include a callee spec), `error <first error line>` for a failed block with no export. "max_bytes" bounds the exported statement's size. Plan step 1.4, issue #316.
